Ifmyante wrote: Please watch this movie

It's not just about food, but about the poison that money and profits truly are

Great movie. One of the first ones I saw about food.

Further research showed that:

A. Conversion rates of meat production are extremely inefficient. i.e.
5-20 kg of dry feed for 1kg gain in Cattle. Then around 2400 liters (750
 gallons) of clean water for production of 1 kg (2 pounds) of meat.
Water numbers are from meat industry so they are definitely ¨adjusted¨

Comment here: dry feed is produced from crops, plants, etc. The food we
actually can consume. 2400 lte of water would be enough for 1 human
being to live for for more than 3 years (averaging 3ltr pr person pr day
 app). Hence it is not sustainable in the long run.

B. There is no difference between animal protein and plant based protein
 as far as human health is concerned. Current trend worldwide is
PROTEIN, PROTEIN, PROTEIN... it is very ridiculous. (The only vitamin
you might lack if you stop eating meat is B12... that's another story in
 itself)

C. Number 1 killer in the world right now is heart and heart related
diseases. Some 30 years back there was groundbreaking study that plant
based diet stops and very often reverts heart related diseases.

The only reason to eat meat based products are habits, culture and ego.
After researching nutrition field for the last 2 years I went vegan.
Great for your health, great for the planet. though it was not easy...
old habits are hard to kill especially when one has them since
childhood.

Other things to research if anyone is interested:

- Cancer rates and animal based food consumption correlation

- heart rate diseases and animal based food consumption correlation

- Short movie on youtube ¨Raw for 30 days¨ - cured diabetes with diet
and fitness in 30 days what is really ridiculous in our modern world

- Book ¨The China study¨

- Hospitals around the world that cure certain kinds of cancer with diets

It's a lot to take in... if you will decide to watch anything and
want to have a good start in the subject watch this movie first Forks Over Knives, featuring a cast of leading doctors, researchers, and Ph.D. holders, backs up it’s claims with solid facts and statistical analyses throughout the movie.
 The strong correlation made between eating animal products, and
mortality due to heart-disease and cancer is particularly scary.

This stuff is extremely unpopular to talk about and discuss in social
circles.. so be aware. Economy would shrink quite a bit if people would
be healthy, would not buy lots of unnecessary drugs, BIG MEAT and BIG
MILK would not make money.

done with the rambling... I hope at least someone has used their time to read it. It is a game changer that anyone can do...
